      "content": {
        "json": "# Azure Arc – Connected Machine Agent Version Compliance\n**What this workbook answers:** ① Are my Azure Arc agents on a **likely supported version (estimate)**? ② Is **automatic agent upgrade** enabled and working? ③ **What must be fixed**, and on which servers?\n\n**How to use it:** choose subscriptions and filters above → **1 Overview** for the big picture and the servers that need action (optional **2 Distribution** charts: *Show distribution charts*) → **3 Advisor** for blockers (expired / disconnected) → **4 Server inventory** for the server list → **5 Automatic upgrade** and **6 Manual upgrade paths** to fix → **7 Policy** to enforce at scale → **8 Extensions** as an extra check. Every table can be filtered and exported to Excel. No version list is maintained in this workbook – the reference is read live from Azure."
      },
      "conditionalVisibility": {
        "parameterName": "Language",
        "comparison": "isEqualTo",
        "value": "EN"
      },
      "name": "intro-en"
    },

Todas as tabelas podem ser filtradas e exportadas para Excel. Nenhuma lista de versões é mantida no workbook – a referência é lida do Azure em tempo real."

              "version": "KqlItem/1.0",
              "query": "resources\n| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions'\n| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/extensions/')[0])), Server = tostring(split(id, '/')[8]), Publisher = tostring(properties.publisher), Extension = tostring(properties.type)\n| extend _msg = tostring(properties.instanceView.status.message), _state = tostring(properties.provisioningState)\n| extend _payload = iff(indexof(_msg, '{') >= 0, parse_json(substring(_msg, indexof(_msg, '{'))), dynamic(null))\n| extend _exit = extract(@'(exit code for \\w+: -?\\d+)', 1, _msg)\n| extend _clean = replace_regex(_msg, @'(?i)(extension (failed to \\w+|returned non-zero exit code for \\w+: -?\\d+|error output|error|message)|std ?(error|out)|running scope as unit\\s*:\\s*\\S+|\\[[A-Za-z]+\\])\\s*[.:]?', ' ')\n| extend _reason = extract(@'(?is)\\b((?:no |not |cannot |can not |unable |missing |could not |denied|access is denied|timeout|timed out|failed to )[^.\\r\\n]{3,140})', 1, _clean)\n| extend _fallback = trim(@'[\\s.,;:]+', substring(trim(@'\\s+', _clean), 0, 160))\n| extend IssueCategory = case(_state =~ 'Failed', 'Failure',\n                              array_length(_payload.healthIssues) > 0, 'Health warning',\n                              _state =~ 'Succeeded', 'OK',\n                              isempty(_state), 'Unknown',\n                              'In progress')\n| extend Issue = case(IssueCategory == 'Failure', strcat(case(isnotempty(_reason), trim(@'[\\s,;:]+', _reason), isnotempty(_fallback), _fallback, 'No detail in status message'), iff(isnotempty(_exit), strcat(' [', _exit, ']'), '')),\n                    IssueCategory == 'Health warning', strcat_array(_payload.healthIssues, '; '),\n                    IssueCategory == 'OK', '-',\n                    _state)\n| extend Issue = replace_regex(Issue, @'[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|\\b[0-9a-fA-F]{20,}\\b', '*')\n| join kind=inner (\n    resources\n    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'\n    | extend _os = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), _st = tostring(properties.status), _au = case(tobool(properties.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade) == true, 'Enabled', tobool(properties.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade) == false, 'Disabled', 'N/A')\n    | where _os in ({OsFilter}) or 'All' in ({OsFilter})\n    | where _st in ({StatusFilter}) or 'All' in ({StatusFilter})\n    | where _au in ({AutoUpgradeFilter}) or 'All' in ({AutoUpgradeFilter})\n    | project machineId = tolower(id)\n) on machineId\n| where IssueCategory != 'OK'\n| summarize Servers = dcount(machineId), AllServers = make_set(Server, 5000) by Extension, IssueCategory, Issue\n| extend p = case(IssueCategory == 'Failure', 1, IssueCategory == 'Health warning', 2, 3)\n| order by p asc, Servers desc\n| project Extension, IssueCategory, Issue, Servers, ServerList = strcat_array(AllServers, ', ')",

        "json": "> ℹ️ **How \"latest\" and status are computed (no hard-coded versions)**\n> - **Latest (per OS)** = highest of: (1) the **auto-upgrade target set by Azure** on any machine (`agentUpgrade.desiredVersion` / `lastAttemptDesiredVersion`), (2) the **Hybrid Compute agent catalog API**, (3) optionally the fleet maximum. **Exception:** if *Latest override* is filled, it takes priority over all of them. Column *LatestSource* shows which one won.\n> - Agent references use the exact `agentVersions/latest` endpoint per OS, not the unstable paged list. Downloads use an exact version; an optional download-only version does not change compliance. No complete release catalog is claimed. Verified on 2026-11-06.\n> - **Versions behind** = minor-version distance to latest. Arc releases are numbered sequentially and shipped monthly ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).\n> - **Supported** is only an estimate: fewer than *{SupportWindow}* sequential releases behind. Policy: only agent versions released within the last year are supported. Confirm exact dates in the release notes.\n> - **Auto-upgrade \"On track\"** = enabled, connected, with no failed last attempt, and ≤ *{AutoUpgradeTolerance}* release(s) behind latest – a heuristic: Microsoft rolls upgrades out in batches by region during off-peak hours and retries failed ones ([automatic agent upgrade](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/automatic-agent-upgrade)). Requirements: agent 1.67 or later; Windows PowerShell execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux cron service; Azure public cloud only. Some Microsoft Learn pages label the feature as preview – confirm its current status.\n> - **Latest can lag the newest release**: it is the highest version Azure reports (auto-upgrade target and catalog API). A release already listed in the [release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) may not appear there yet; use *Latest override* to force it.\n> - For **Disconnected/Expired** servers the agent version is the **last reported** value.\n>\n> ⚠️ *Disclaimer*: auxiliary tool provided as-is; it does not replace official Microsoft compliance reporting.\n> - **Security floor** (default 1.61, Edit mode): agents below it are flagged *Below security floor* independently of the support window. Basis: CVE-2026-26117 affects agents < 1.61 and CVE-2025-49692 affects agents < 1.49 (CVE records); CVE-2025-26627 and CVE-2025-55316 are listed as in *Arc Posture Review*. The two advisories checked describe the Windows agent, while the floor is applied to every operating system. The release notes list newer security fixes (for example 1.63 CVE-2026-2673 on Linux, 1.65 CVE-2026-47632) – consider raising the floor. At or above this configurable floor is NOT a security verdict; review the threshold and newly published fixes regularly."

A coluna *LatestSource* mostra qual prevaleceu.\n> - As referências usam o endpoint exato `agentVersions/latest` por SO, não a listagem paginada instável. Downloads consultam a versão exata; a versão opcional de download não altera a conformidade. Não se promete catálogo completo de releases. Verificado em 2026-11-06.\n> - **Versões atrás** = distância de versão menor até a latest. As releases do Arc são numeradas em sequência e mensais ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).\n> - **Supported** é somente uma estimativa: menos de *{SupportWindow}* releases sequenciais atrás. Política: só versões do agent lançadas no último ano são suportadas. Confirme as datas nas release notes.\n> - **Upgrade automático \"On track\"** = ativo, conectado, sem falha na última tentativa e ≤ *{AutoUpgradeTolerance}* release atrás da latest – uma heurística: a Microsoft libera os upgrades em lotes por região, fora do horário de pico, e repete os que falham ([upgrade automático do agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/automatic-agent-upgrade)). Requisitos: agent 1.67 ou superior; Windows com execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux com serviço cron; somente nuvem pública do Azure. Algumas páginas do Microsoft Learn rotulam o recurso como preview – confirme o status atual.\n> - **A latest pode estar atrás da release mais nova**: é a maior versão que o Azure informa (alvo do upgrade automático e API de catálogo). Uma release já listada nas [release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) pode ainda não aparecer ali; use o *Latest override* para forçá-la.\n> - Para servidores **Disconnected/Expired**, a versão do agent é o **último valor reportado**.\n> - **Piso de segurança** (padrão 1.61, modo Edit): agents abaixo dele são marcados *Below security floor* independentemente da janela de suporte.
